alveolar point.d: craniometric point that is the most anterior point in the midline on the alveolar process of the maxilla

alveolar process.d: a ridge that forms the borders of the upper and lower jaws and contains the sockets of the teeth

alveolar bed.d: lung tissue densely packed with alveoli

alveolar arch.d: the part of the upper or lower jawbones in which the teeth are set

alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma.d: form of rhabdomyosarcoma occurring mainly in adolescents and young adults

alveolar rhabdosarcoma.d: form of rhabdomyosarcoma occurring mainly in adolescents and young adults

alveolar ectasia.d: abnormal enlargement of the air sacs in the lungs

alveolar artery.d: a branch of the maxillary artery that supplies the alveolar process

alveolar consonant.d: a consonant articulated with the tip of the tongue near the gum ridge

alveolar ridge.d: a ridge that forms the borders of the upper and lower jaws and contains the sockets of the teeth

alveolitis.d: inflammation in the socket of a tooth; sometimes occurs after a tooth is extracted and a blood clot fails to form

alveolar.d: a consonant articulated with the tip of the tongue near the gum ridge

alveolus.d: a tiny sac for holding air in the lungs; formed by the terminal dilation of tiny air passageways

alveolate.d: pitted with cell-like cavities (as a honeycomb)

alvine.d: of or relating to the intestines
